prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, redesign] Visual Cloud Restore Status & Account Link Portal: Overhaul the sign-in screen to feature prominent cloud pet recovery guarantees and a visual sync status preview before authentication. (why: 8 support emails report pets missing or reset after signing in again, making account sign-in a top point of user anxiety.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Control & Taskbar Hide Interactive Sandbox: Add a new interactive practice screen right before onboarding completion where users try out hiding, summoning, and interacting with their pet on screen. (why: Multiple support emails detail user confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after completing setup.)
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop Rendering Readiness Live Diagnostic Card: Add a desktop display overlay diagnostic status block on the waiting screen showing GPU and screen overlay compatibility. (why: 3 support tickets report pets failing to appear on the desktop or the app stalling at startup.)
3: [adoption, layout] Split Canvas Custom Pet Photo Alignment Guide: Change photo upload screen layout to a split view with live pose alignment framing to prevent photo upload generation failures. (why: Support mailbox received bug reports regarding custom pet generation failures or distorted results.)
4: [finish, hint] Desktop Companion Hotkey & Tray Interaction Callout: Display a persistent hotkey reference banner and tray minimize reminder on the final setup completion screen. (why: Users contact support post-onboarding asking how to minimize or talk to their pet once setup completes.)
5: [sign_in, copy] Account Persistence & Multi-Device Pet Recovery Reassurance: Update sign-in screen copy to explicitly guarantee existing pet recovery and data protection during account auth. (why: Largest support theme (8 reports) involves user anxiety and actual occurrences of missing/reset pets after sign in.)
6: [home, notification] Background Asset Render Completion Notification Sound: Enable sound alerts and a ready-to-launch visual notification banner when pet generation completes on the waiting screen. (why: Median waiting screen time is 201s with a high mean of 2336s, showing users switch away and forget the app while waiting.)
